clue.text: Male editor in charge consumed drug

parts.note: ate means consumed

explanation.surface: A newspaper story: a male editor in charge has swallowed some drug.
explanation.definitionFit: To medicate someone is to treat them with medicine, so the verb sense of drug fits.

clue.text: Anger from tot overwhelmed by people

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means engulfed, so the word for tot is swallowed by the people

parts.note: men means people in the old general sense
to tot up is to add

explanation.surface: A toddler swamped by a crowd of people gets angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tot' looks like a small child but is the verb meaning add up.
explanation.definitionFit: To madden is to make someone furious, which is the verb sense of anger.

clue.text: Devalues sad works of drama

parts.note: down means sad or depressed
plays are works of drama

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses some gloomy dramatic works.
explanation.definitionFit: To downplay something is to make it seem less important, minimising its worth.

clue.text: Officer and soldiers — a party emerges somewhere in America

parts.note: COL is short for colonel, an army officer
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers
a do is a party
springs means emerges, as in springs up

explanation.surface: An officer and his soldiers turn up at a party somewhere in the US.
explanation.definitionFit: Colorado Springs is a city in Colorado in the United States.

clue.text: Premium log with opening cut out is garden decoration

parts.note: top means premium, of the highest quality

indicators.note: with opening cut out says the first letter of the word for log is removed

parts.note: a diary is a log, a daily record

explanation.surface: A fine log with its end sawn off is used as a garden ornament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'log' looks like timber but is the record kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Topiary is shrubs clipped into ornamental shapes as garden decoration.

clue.text: Drains American energy drink

parts.note: US stands for the United States, so American
E is the physics symbol for energy
to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: A US energy drink seems to sap whoever downs it.
explanation.definitionFit: Uses up and drains both mean exhausting a supply completely.

clue.text: Residence undergraduate keeps privately in Isle of Man

indicators.note: keeps means holds inside, so the student contains the rest

parts.note: an undergraduate is a student

indicators.note: in means placed inside the island's abbreviation

parts.note: apart means aside or privately, away from others

explanation.surface: A student lives quietly on the Isle of Man, an island between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: APART goes 'in' IOM, giving IOAPARTM, and STUDENT 'keeps' that.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio apartment is a one-room flat, a kind of residence.

clue.text: Bird coming from southern bank

parts.note: to bank is to tilt, as an aircraft does in a turn

explanation.surface: A bird emerges from a southern riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like a riverside but is the verb of a turning plane.
explanation.definitionFit: The stilt is a long-legged wading bird.

clue.text: Precisely locate leg and hip trapped by vessel

parts.note: pins is slang for legs, so a pin is a leg

indicators.note: trapped by means caught inside, so the word for hip sits in the vessel

parts.note: a pot is a vessel
in means fashionable, as does hip

explanation.surface: An injury report: leg and hip caught in some kind of vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To pinpoint something is to find or identify its exact position.

clue.text: Remains suspended from hospital on account of last of errors

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
over means on account of, as in a row over money

indicators.note: last of means the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A hospital worker is suspended pending a ruling on a string of errors.
explanation.definitionFit: To hover is to stay suspended in the air in one place.

clue.text: Fastener's shine diminished

indicators.note: diminished says the phrase is made smaller by losing a letter, here one of its pair of Ls

parts.note: to shine is to do well, to excel

explanation.surface: A fastener's shiny finish has dulled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fastener's' is Fastener is. DO WELL (shine) loses an L.
explanation.definitionFit: A dowel is a wooden peg used to join two pieces of wood together.

clue.text: Master bonding to gain wealth

parts.note: a pro is an expert, a master of a craft
fusion is a joining or bonding together

explanation.surface: Advice that mastering some kind of bonding will make you rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Profusion means abundance, a great wealth of something, as in a wealth of detail.

clue.text: Urge tape to be broadcast, circumventing cross censor

indicators.note: circumventing means going round, so the shuffled letters go round the cross
broadcast as scattering seed means the letters of urge tape are spread about anew

parts.note: X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: Someone presses for a tape to be aired while a cross censor tries to get round it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be broadcast' rearranges URGE TAPE into EPURGATE, and 'circumventing' wraps those letters round X.
explanation.definitionFit: To expurgate a text is to remove objectionable material, which is what a censor does as a verb.

clue.text: Part of song Mint Royale sampled

indicators.note: sampled says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The band Mint Royale sampled part of somebody else's song.
explanation.definitionFit: An intro is the opening section of a piece of music, before the verse begins.

clue.text: Barely fifty brave guards

indicators.note: guards means holds within, so the word for brave encloses the numeral

parts.note: hardy means bold and able to endure, so brave
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Hardly anyone: barely fifty brave souls are on guard duty.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardly and barely are synonyms meaning only just, scarcely.

clue.text: Somehow discontented meeting an itinerant in Oz

indicators.note: discontented means with its contents removed, leaving only the outside letters of the word

parts.note: AGM is an annual general meeting

explanation.surface: A disgruntled person meets a wanderer in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: A swagman is an Australian tramp who carried his belongings in a bundle, the swag.

clue.text: Eccentric this manic is engineer

indicators.note: eccentric means off-centre or odd, so these letters are put in a strange new order

explanation.surface: This manic, eccentric person is an engineer.
explanation.definitionFit: A machinist makes or operates machines, a kind of engineer.

clue.text: Following joke, the French daughter snapped

parts.note: a crack is a wisecrack, a joke
le is French for the
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: After a joke, the French daughter lost her temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackled means made sharp popping noises, a series of snaps.

clue.text: Checks son's entered into further exams

indicators.note: entered into means put inside, so the letter goes in among the exams

parts.note: resits are exams taken again after failing
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A parent checks that their son is entered for more resits.
explanation.definitionFit: To check an attack or an advance is to hold it back, which is what resists means.

clue.text: With Human Resources involved, decline contract

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up in, so the abbreviation goes inside the word for decline

parts.note: to sink is to decline or fall
HR is the usual abbreviation for Human Resources

explanation.surface: Human Resources step in when someone turns down a work contract.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a noun in the surface but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To shrink is to become smaller, the verb sense of contract.

clue.text: Regularly snacked on tea break

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the regular letters from snacked follow the word for tea

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: regularly means taking letters at even intervals, here the second, fourth and sixth

explanation.surface: Someone regularly snacks during a tea break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regularly' takes N, C, E from snacked, which go after CHA.
explanation.definitionFit: A break is a lucky opportunity, as in give me a break, which is a chance.

clue.text: Challenge done with learner absent

indicators.note: absent says the learner's letter is missing from the word for done

parts.note: complete means done or finished
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A challenge is finished without the learner taking part.
explanation.definitionFit: To challenge a rival is to contend or vie with them, which is what compete means.

clue.text: Matched silver on base with diamonds

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
re means on, concerning
e is the base of natural logarithms
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: A jeweller matches silver to a base set with diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Two accounts that agreed tallied or corresponded, so they matched.

clue.text: Half of sled used in vehicle made of wood

indicators.note: used in means placed inside, so the half of sled goes into the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle

indicators.note: half of picks two of the four letters of sled, here the second pair

explanation.surface: Half a sled was used in building a wooden vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Cedar is a coniferous tree whose fragrant timber is a common wood.

clue.text: Something used to pacify the young model

definitions.text: Something used to pacify the young
definitions.meaning: a rubber teat given to a baby to suck, what Americans call a pacifier
a ... is a model figure, as a tailor's or shop-window ...

explanation.surface: A soothing aid for babies is offered alongside a model.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy is both a baby's comforter and a mock-up figure used to display clothes.

clue.text: Relaxing occasion recalled by leader of tourists in group

indicators.note: in means the two pieces sit inside the group

parts.note: a ring is a group such as a gang or cartel

indicators.note: recalled, called back, means the word for occasion runs backwards

parts.note: time means occasion, as in the first time

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A tour leader relaxes, recalling an occasion in the group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' reverses the occasion word, and 'in' puts it, plus T, inside the group word.
explanation.definitionFit: Remitting as in a fever or pressure remitting means slackening or easing off, so relaxing.

clue.text: Brightness displayed by uncle, man travelling around India

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters go round the letter for India
travelling means moving about, so the letters of uncle and man change places

parts.note: I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An uncle and another man travel around India, showing off their brilliance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travelling' shuffles the eight letters into LUMNANCE, which goes 'around' I.
explanation.definitionFit: Luminance is the measured intensity of light from a surface, its brightness.

clue.text: European metric measure not right choice

indicators.note: not says the letter for right is left out of the measure

parts.note: a litre is a metric measure of volume

explanation.surface: A European says the metric system is not the right choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Elite and choice as adjectives both mean the best, of select quality.

clue.text: Sort of husky really emptied feeding bowl

indicators.note: feeding means going into, so the emptied word goes inside the bowl

parts.note: a dish is a shallow bowl

indicators.note: emptied means the inside letters are removed, leaving only the outer ones

explanation.surface: A husky dog's food bowl has been well and truly emptied.
explanation.definitionFit: A husky voice is rough and dry, so a somewhat dry one is a sort of husky.

clue.text: Again told fact collected by grass

indicators.note: collected by means taken inside, so the fact sits in the grass

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wet places
stat is short for statistic, a numerical fact

explanation.surface: A fact gathered by an informer is told again.
explanation.walkthrough: Grass is also British slang for an informer, which the surface trades on.
explanation.definitionFit: Restated is past tense of restate: said or told once more.
